---
title: "A language Pandoc cannot highlight, on blocks with no title"
filters:
  - code-window
---

The first two blocks refuse a title, so nothing reads a derived label and each
keeps the class the author wrote. The last two get a title, from the language
or from the filename, and are relabelled.

```{.foo code-window-no-auto-filename="true"}
x = 1
```

```{.foo code-window-enabled="false"}
y = 2
```

```foo
z = 3
```

```{.foo filename="w.foo" code-window-no-auto-filename="true"}
w = 4
```
